task_description: Author and deploy Mythos-grade frontend skill (frontend-mythos) with 3-level progressive disclosure architecture, strict design tokens, deterministic state machines, WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, client-side security, and boilerplate starter assets.

changes_made.summary: Created Level 1 & Level 2 core directives with YAML frontmatter, 5-phase progressive workflow, anti-slop blacklist, anti-rationalization table, and red flags list.
Codified base-4/base-8 linear spatial scale, 4-tier functional color layers, WCAG 2.2 contrast ratios, nested radius geometry (R_inner = R_outer - padding), and fluid typography.
Codified discriminated union async states, enterprise form reducer, optimistic mutations with rollback mechanics, and real-time streaming state machine with exponential backoff and jitter.
Codified WCAG 2.2 AA non-negotiable contract, focus trapping hook (useFocusTrap), roving tabindex keyboard navigation, 44x44px touch targets, aria-live regions, and accessible skip-links.
Codified context-aware DOMPurify sanitization, reverse tabnabbing defense (rel='noopener noreferrer'), URL scheme allowlisting, zero client secret leaks, and CSP directives.
Provided starter templates: tailwind.config.example.js, AccessibleModal.example.tsx, useOptimisticReducer.example.ts, and accessible SVG icons (close, check, alert, spinner, search).
Mirrored complete skill architecture to project root .claude/skills/frontend-mythos/ for Claude CLI and Claude.ai packaging.
Mirrored complete skill architecture to user config directory for global agent discovery.
